title: Following a Path: Pure Pursuit and Stanley, Where Each Cuts the Curve or Swings Across the Line

artifact.note: path followers for a car: pure pursuit steers along the arc that reaches a point a lookahead distance ahead on the path; Stanley steers by the heading error plus an angle from the cross-track error of the front axle; a signed cross-track distance, a nearest-point search that only moves forward, and a run of the bicycle model that reports the worst and final error
